title: Writing an email, and signing it off

card.title: Writing an email, and signing it off
card.sub: Write an email from a company's page. It waits in the Outbox until you sign it off with your browser's key.
card.foot: A made-up person, Sam Sample. In the demo nothing is written anywhere and nothing is sent.

scenes.caption: Write an email from a company's page. It waits in the Outbox until you sign it off.
On a company's page, open Write an email: who it goes to, a subject and the text. Nothing is sent from here.

fill: Hello Rui, here are the answers to your questions on the proposal.

scenes.caption: Here, to Rui Kowalski, with the answers to their questions on the proposal.
Show what will be written shows the email as the file it becomes in the Outbox. Then Write it.
In the Outbox it waits: Not signed off.

do.click: main tr:has-text("Answers on the proposal") button:has-text("Sign off")

scenes.caption: Sign off signs this exact email with your browser's key, for one batch. The signature and fingerprints are hidden here.
Write it, and the Outbox shows Signed off by you, ready for its batch.

card.title: Then it is sent
card.sub: The Email Cell's page checks every signature again and sends the batch on one press. In the demo, nothing is sent.

scenes.caption: The Email Cell's page checks every signature again and sends the batch on one press. In the demo, nothing is sent.
